# termbox2

Vendored from [termbox2](https://github.com/termbox/termbox2), release
[v2.5.0](https://github.com/termbox/termbox2/releases/tag/v2.5.0).

- Commit: `9b5a5da862c06c554148c14fd38d2f796be22d57`
- `termbox2.h` SHA-256: `ef63b6bd6e3a1c8ad339b7aa0bf52dc21f3e92bd886264ebe588ab86ccd1e5d1`
- License: [MIT](LICENSE).

The POSIX Life front end compiles the unmodified header through
[../../examples/life/termbox_shim.c](../../examples/life/termbox_shim.c), with
the default 16-bit attributes. The portable backend has no C dependency.
